documents.title: Gynecologic oncology surveillance letter
documents.author: gynecologic oncology
documents.body:
Gynecologic Oncology — Surveillance Visit
Date of service: 02/09/2023

Dear Doctor,

Mrs. Kenney is two and a half years out from staging surgery for an adult granulosa cell tumor, stage IA. We noted her ICU stay last summer for myasthenic crisis; she has recovered.

No bleeding, pain, bloating or early satiety. Abdomen soft, no masses. Vaginal cuff intact; bimanual and rectovaginal exams without masses or nodularity. Inhibin B within normal limits.

No evidence of recurrence. Moving to yearly visits with inhibin B.

Gynecologic Oncology

documents.title: Medicare Annual Wellness Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
ANNUAL WELLNESS VISIT

HRA: independent in daily activities and household tasks; drives in town; still at the archive part time. No falls. Lives with husband. Sleeps well. Wine once or twice a week.

Interval: gyn onc in February, all clear, now yearly. Saw neurology two weeks ago: she says strength is normal, no medication change, see them next year. We don't have their note.

PHQ-2 0. Memory: sharp in conversation, no concerns raised.

Exam: vitals as charted. No ptosis. Lungs diminished at the bases without wheeze. Heart regular. Abdomen soft. No edema. Knees crepitant.

Prevention: mammogram 11/2022 negative, colonoscopy 2017, Shingrix, PCV20, Tdap 2015 (due 2025), COVID bivalent fall 2022. RSV vaccine this fall when available; she qualifies with COPD.

Labs today: CMP, CBC, lipids.
Plan: neurology note requested. Follow-up in the fall.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Irene, your labs are normal across the board, including calcium, kidney and liver function and blood counts. Cholesterol is stable. Nothing to do.

documents.title: Refill
documents.author: patient
documents.body: The mail order says my hydrochlorothiazide needs a new prescription. Could you send it? Thank you, Irene

documents.title: Re: Refill
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Hi Irene, the doctor sent hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg, 90 days with 3 refills, to your mail-order pharmacy this morning.

documents.title: Nurse Visit — Flu, COVID, RSV
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Pt chose to get all three today. High-dose flu left deltoid, 2023-24 Pfizer COVID right deltoid, RSV (Arexvy) left deltoid, separated by 1 inch. Screening negative. Advised a sore arm or tiredness for a day or two is common. Observed 15 minutes, no reaction.

orders.order: DXA bone density, hip and spine

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Office Visit — Follow-up
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Six-month check. Tired for a day after her three shots, fine since.

COPD: same, no flares this year. Theophylline 200 BID.
MG: no symptoms. MS: no relapse; caths without trouble, no UTIs this year.
HTN: at goal on HCTZ.
Bones: last DXA December 2019 before the parathyroid surgery; due for a repeat to see whether the forearm has improved.

Neurology note from April never arrived; she says nothing changed.

Exam: vitals as charted. No ptosis. Lungs diminished, no wheeze. Heart regular. No edema.

Plan: DXA early next year. Mammogram November. Wellness April.

reports.text: Bilateral digital screening mammogram with tomosynthesis. Scattered fibroglandular density. No mass, suspicious calcifications or distortion. Unchanged from prior.

documents.title: Catheter supplier — yearly renewal
documents.author: front desk
documents.body:
Supply company faxed their yearly certificate of medical necessity for intermittent catheters, same quantity as before. In PCP box.

PCP signed 12/12; faxed back. Supplier confirmed receipt.

reports.study: DXA bone density, hip and spine
reports.text:
Dual-energy x-ray absorptiometry of the lumbar spine, left hip and left forearm, same scanner as 12/2019.
L1-L4: T-score -1.3 (previously -1.6).
Left femoral neck: T-score -1.7 (previously -2.0).
Left total hip: T-score -1.2 (previously -1.4).
Left distal one-third radius: T-score -2.0 (previously -2.3).
reports.conclusion: Low bone mass (osteopenia), improved at all sites since December 2019.

documents.title: Bone density result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Irene, good news: your bone density went up at every site since 2019, including the forearm, which is what we hoped for after the parathyroid surgery. Still in the osteopenia range, not osteoporosis. Keep the calcium, vitamin D and walking. No medicine needed.

documents.title: Re: Bone density result
documents.author: patient
documents.body: That's wonderful, thank you. Also, I saw the cancer doctor last week for my yearly visit and she said everything looks fine and the blood test was normal. I don't know if she sends you anything.

documents.title: Medicare Annual Wellness Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
WELLNESS VISIT

HRA: independent, drives, gardens, library archive two mornings. Husband well. No falls. No hearing concerns.

Interval: DXA in February improved. Gyn onc yearly visit in February by her report: no recurrence, normal inhibin; no letter received. Neurology next month.

PHQ-2 0. Conversation, recall and judgment normal.

Exam: vitals as charted. No ptosis. Lungs diminished, no wheeze. Heart regular. No edema. Strength full.

Prevention: mammogram 11/2023 negative. Colonoscopy 2017, next 2027. Vaccines up to date; Tdap due next year.

Labs: CMP, CBC and a theophylline level (last 10.6 in 2022).
Follow-up in the fall.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs normal. Theophylline 11.8, right in range. Calcium normal.

documents.title: Neurology clinic follow-up letter
documents.author: neurology
documents.body:
Neurology Clinic — Follow-up
Date of service: 05/15/2024

Dear Colleague,

Yearly visit for generalized myasthenia gravis (post-thymectomy, crisis in 2022 after ciprofloxacin) and relapsing-remitting MS.

She reports no fluctuating weakness, diplopia, dysphagia or new neurological symptoms. No MS relapse.

Exam: no ptosis with sustained upgaze, full extraocular movements, normal bulbar function, neck flexion and limb strength full and not fatigable. Gait normal.

Plan: continue pyridostigmine 60 mg three times daily. Medication avoidance list reviewed again. Return in 12 months.

Neurology Clinic

documents.author: MA
documents.body: High-dose trivalent flu IM left deltoid; 2024-25 Pfizer COVID IM right deltoid. Screening negative. RSV already done 2023. Tolerated well.

documents.title: Office Visit — Follow-up
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Rescheduled from last week. Feeling well.

Neurology in May: stable, no changes (letter in chart).
COPD: baseline, no flares, no ER visits this year.
HTN: at goal; BMP on HCTZ today.
Knees: acetaminophen most evenings, keeps walking.
No UTIs this year.

Exam: vitals as charted. No ptosis. Lungs diminished, no wheeze. Heart regular. Knees crepitant, no effusion.

Plan: no medication changes. Mammogram in two weeks. Wellness visit in April with Tdap.

reports.text: Bilateral digital screening mammogram with tomosynthesis. Scattered fibroglandular density. No suspicious mass, calcification or architectural distortion. Stable.
